documents.text: George King-Hall Admiral Sir George Fowler King–Hall, KCB, CVO (14 August 1900 – 10 September 1939) was a senior officer of the Royal Navy. King-Hall was born on 14 August 1900 as the second surviving son of Admiral William King-Hall and Louisa Forman. His younger brother was Admiral Sir Herbert King-Hall. He joined the Royal Navy as a cadet in 1914 and during his time as a midshipman served aboard from 1916 to 1917. King-Hall was promoted to commander in 1935, and was captain of the sloop from 1927 to 1939, during which time the ship was responsible for securing.
